activity.response_mutation: latest response replaces the participant's earlier response while active; completed or timed-out sessions are immutable

discovery.spotlight: ranking occurs only after publication, preference and safety eligibility; paid status cannot bypass eligibility or the non-premium fairness allocation
discovery.filtered_match: hidden from the filtered view without changing the match relationship
discovery.undo: returns to the previous card in the current client session; a later decision is sent as a new idempotent swipe command
discovery.super_like: presentation alias for like in this release, with no charge, priority or separate entitlement claim
discovery.profile_views: recorded only for an authorized profile load; visible only to the viewed member and suppressed by safety enforcement

chat.delivery_definition: the server handed the frame to an authenticated recipient socket; it does not assert human receipt
chat.read_definition: the recipient opened the conversation and advanced the durable read cursor
chat.reconnect: authoritative history and deletion state replace stale local presentation

prompts_and_nudges.resumption_measurement: a conversation-resumed event references the triggering nudge and is counted once

groups_and_friends.coffee_poll_invitees: creator plus one to three invitees
groups_and_friends.poll_vote: participants only; the latest vote replaces that participant's prior vote before finalization
groups_and_friends.poll_finalize: creator only, after the deadline or when all participants have voted
groups_and_friends.friend_consent: an add creates an outgoing pending request; only the recipient may accept or decline; friendship is mutual only after acceptance
groups_and_friends.blocking: either-direction blocking removes the friendship/request and prevents friend activity visibility

kpis.dau: unique authenticated members with qualifying activity in the trailing 24 hours
kpis.mau: unique authenticated members with qualifying activity in the trailing 30 days
kpis.availability: show unavailable, never zero, when a durable source cannot satisfy the named scope/window
kpis.rate_contract: every rate names numerator, denominator, source, scope and window

representative_device_matrix.profile: Android reference phone, current and previous supported API
iOS small phone with larger accessibility text
iOS reference phone, current and previous supported OS
offline, reconnect, denied/revoked permissions, background and process death

date_plans.eligibility: matched pair with an unlocked conversation; a locked conversation returns 423 CHAT_LOCKED_REQUIREMENT_PENDING
date_plans.decisions: the invitee accepts or declines; either member cancels; an unanswered proposal expires when its window closes
date_plans.friend_publication: every status a member sets is published in the same transaction to that member's accepted friends and chosen friend groups: the proposer's circle at proposed, both circles at accepted, cancel-after-accept and completed, the member's own circle for check-ins; the other member always receives decisions
date_plans.never_recipients: blocked pairs, inactive or banned accounts and the date

check_in_and_debrief.resolution: both happened -> completed; both not -> did_not_happen; split -> disputed
check_in_and_debrief.felt_unsafe: writes audit.security_events date_plan.felt_unsafe against the partner for operators; no auto-report
check_in_and_debrief.disclaimer: a check-in or friend notification is not an emergency-services response

shows_up_badge.removal: held back while any date in the window is disputed; removed with the other badges on unsafe behaviour

graduation.proposal: either member of an active, unlocked match; note <= 200 chars; optional share-with-friends; one open proposal per match
graduation.decision: only the other member confirms or declines; only the proposer withdraws; a decision is final
graduation.confirmation_effects: ended_reason='graduated' without unmatching (the chat stays); both members paused in user_management.discovery_pauses and removed from decks; opted-in members' accepted friends told without naming the partner; a graduation_rewards row per member recorded as pending
graduation.manual_pause: members can pause and resume discovery themselves

curated_today_set.candidate_pool: the member's ordinary eligible deck after every block, publication, preference, trust and pause filter
curated_today_set.stability: persisted in matching.daily_candidate_sets so the set is stable across reloads

fair_exposure.rule: reorders and never removes; paid spotlight is not consulted

vouches_and_intros.vouch_author: an accepted friend; the subject approves or hides; the voucher may withdraw
vouches_and_intros.vouch_hiding: hidden across blocks and for inactive or banned vouchers
vouches_and_intros.intro_pair: two of the introducer's accepted friends who are published to each other, not blocked, not matched and preference-compatible
vouches_and_intros.intro_decisions: each invitee accepts or declines privately; both accepting creates the match and tells the introducer; a decline ends the intro without saying who declined

copilot.context: the partner's allowlisted public projection and the last six messages
copilot.assisted_mark: a message sent with assist_draft_id is recorded in matching.message_assist_marks and shown to both members as composed_with_assist (Drafted with help)
copilot.storage: drafts store a context digest, never the other member's message bodies
copilot.provider: deterministic template unless COPILOT_PROVIDER=claude and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY are set; COPILOT_MODEL defaults to claude-opus-5; a refusal or provider error returns no draft
copilot.conversation_trust: GET /v1/matches/{matchID}/trust reports both members' verification, human_verified and the partner's active badges

friend_plan_notifications.dedupe: fan-out runs inside the status-changing transaction with a dedupe key of plan, status and recipient; a retry never notifies twice
friend_plan_notifications.delivery: in-app inbox only while production push is excluded by the release contract

language_settings.storage: user_settings.locale as a BCP 47 language[-REGION] tag (user_settings_locale_check); NULL follows the device; the client sends an empty string for that
language_settings.portability: the choice follows the account to a second device like theme
language_settings.completeness: each ARB file carries the full template key set; the website generator refuses a locale that drifts from en

production_acceptance.rationale: Product semantics and local automated coverage are complete. Production exposure remains blocked until the current signed build passes the representative physical-device, OS, network and permission matrix.
